D.treatment: pre-test incorrect, post-test correct on question 3
D.comparison: pre-test incorrect, post-test incorrect on question 3

O.outcome_detail: change in physics self-efficacy over the semester

cells.quote: The average self-efficacy of the subset of these students who answered question 3 incorrectly on the post-test (N = 125) decreased over the semester while the average self-efficacy of the subset of these students who answered question 3 correctly on the post-test (N = 58) increased; the Z-statistic for this comparison is 2.19.
cells.note: Among students who answered question 3 incorrectly on the pre-test (N = 183), the post-test-correct group showed increased self-efficacy compared with decreased self-efficacy in the post-test-incorrect group.
